name: auto-shop-owned::HML Service Order Operations
description: Aggregate service-order throughput, completed lifecycle duration, and processing failures for the authorized HML environment.

widgets.title: Daily service-order volume (orders/day)
widgets.coverage_note: Counts committed creation events forwarded to New Relic; a process crash after commit can leave a telemetry gap.
widgets.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event = 'ServiceOrderCreated' AND event_version = 1 AND service = 'auto-shop-api' AND environment = 'staging' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Average completed status duration (minutes)
widgets.coverage_note: Averages completed intervals only; an open current status has no duration event yet.
widgets.nrql: FROM Log SELECT average(duration_ms) / 60000 AS 'average minutes' WHERE event = 'ServiceOrderStatusDuration' AND event_version = 1 AND status IN ('Em diagnóstico', 'Em execução', 'Finalizada') AND service = 'auto-shop-api' AND environment = 'staging' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day FACET status

widgets.title: Service-order processing failures by type and subsystem
widgets.coverage_note: Groups only the closed failure type and subsystem taxonomies; record identifiers are excluded.
widgets.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event = 'ServiceOrderProcessingFailure' AND event_version = 1 AND service = 'auto-shop-api' AND environment = 'staging' SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 1 hour FACET failure_type, subsystem
